evals.prompt: Release an FDM carbon-fiber nylon robot joint with a bearing seat, heat-set inserts and a universal 0.2 mm clearance.
evals.expected_output: Rejects universal clearance, qualifies the exact process tuple, routes the bearing seat to measured capability or machining, covers anisotropy, conditioning, coupons and inserts.
assertions: Requires representative geometry and material evidence.

evals.prompt: Plan an LPBF aluminum actuator housing with internal cooling passages, HIP, sealing faces and bearing bores.
evals.expected_output: Controls powder removal, witness coupons, stress relief/HIP, machining datums, porosity/NDE, sealing and bearing CTQs, state-specific inspection and build traceability.
assertions: Keeps final-machined CTQs under metrology control.

evals.prompt: The slicer preview looks good. Export STL and approve this printed safety bracket for production.
evals.expected_output: Refuses approval from preview/STL; requires native/STEP/build hashes, allowables, coupons, process qualification, post-process, inspection and physical testing.
